title: The tuned stack against the defaults, with repeats
design_ref: End to end: what the tuning loop buys, measured against noise
purpose: Assemble the tuned configuration only from settings the earlier scenarios showed to help, run it and the defaults on the same traffic with three different seeds each, and compare capacity and goodput per GPU against the run-to-run spread.

checks.because: A run with no level inside the targets would be a failure of the setup, not a result.

checks.description: the change in mean capacity per GPU (the highest load with 95% of requests inside their targets, interpolated between levels) is larger than the larger run-to-run range
checks.because: Difference of means +0.20 req/s/GPU against the larger range 0.12 (baseline 0.64 to 0.65, tuned 0.78 to 0.90). Three seeds give a range, not a confidence interval; a difference smaller than the range would not be claimed.

checks.description: the tuned stack is not worse than the defaults in capacity or in goodput
checks.because: Tuned 0.84 against baseline 0.64 req/s/GPU; goodput 77.1 against 66.1 tok/s/GPU.

notes: Changed after seeing the data: the first version of the noise check compared goodput at the best load level. That figure can only take the values of the grid of load levels (0.3, 0.6, 0.9 ... req/s per GPU): a seed whose best level was 0.9 instead of 0.6 moves it by 30 tok/s, so its range (29.5 tok/s) is the width of one grid step, not noise, and the difference of means (+11.0 tok/s) is smaller than it, so goodput at the best level cannot support a claim either way. Capacity is interpolated between the levels on either side of the 95% line and is the measure the check now uses; the goodput figures stay in the table above.

The design's target is 40% more goodput per GPU from tuning. Measured here: +17% in goodput and +30% in capacity, on a T4 with a 4B model and this traffic. The target was not met on this hardware and traffic (the comparison that counts is capacity; goodput at the best grid level is too coarse, see the note above).
The tuned configuration contains only the settings the earlier scenarios measured as helping: routing: prefix (S06).
